draft.subject: Your first project on Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Following up on our getting started call last week -- I know the first setup step is easy to put off when things are busy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project up is usually the thing that makes the rest click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
